scope: User-selected follow-ups 2, 3 and 4: consumer AI search baseline, conversion journeys, crawler/indexing verification

consumerBaseline.pilotFindings: Recovered branded answers from ChatGPT and Gemini both mention BioMate and link to its official website. A separate ChatGPT prompt 5 (non-branded RNA-seq comparison) also includes BioMate and links to its website. Gemini prompt 5 ended in a service error. These observations are not an overall visibility score. ChatGPT's explicit search activity was not archived, so searchRan is conservatively unknown despite Web search being selected and source chips being present.
consumerBaseline.qualityFinding: Gemini's branded answer says SOC 2 Type II compliant, whereas the cited features page says aligned to SOC 2 Type II. It also presents closed-loop peptide optimization without the research-stage qualification visible on the research-engines page. Do not treat brand inclusion as answer accuracy.

journeys.contactActualScriptTests: JSDOM runs the real inline contact script with mocked fetch; no real messages sent. Tests cover plain-text URL prefill, invalid fields, pending state, duplicate submit guard, success only after OK response, HTTP rejection, network failure, timeout, input preservation and successful retry.
bugsReproducedBeforeFix: Repeated submit events dispatched two requests while one was pending.
No timeout existed: an unresolved request could leave the submit button disabled indefinitely.
localFixes: Ignore submit while pending; abort after 20 seconds; clear timer after completion.
Announce success/error accessibly; failure wording does not falsely establish that nothing was sent, and warns of possible duplicates on retry.
notVerified: Real contact delivery to company inbox
Mobile platform-to-registration journey; mobile coverage focused on drug discovery
Exhaustive keyboard/screen-reader behavior across every page
journeys.limitations: Connected static links and mocked fetch are not an end-to-end live delivery test. Prior mobile traversal results are not counted as new journey results.
copyFindings: Contact privacy note says information is not shared with third parties, although the form uses Formspree as a processor. Requires privacy-policy review, not an invented legal claim.
Contact structured FAQ references Pro plans while pricing uses Starter/Premium/Team/Enterprise; reconcile the commercial facts before rewriting.

crawlerAndIndexing.limitations: Synthetic user agents establish only that these requests were served. They do not identify genuine provider crawlers or prove indexing, ranking or citation inclusion. Other nginx access logs cannot be attributed to this vhost because its logging is disabled. Existing verified webmaster property access is still required.
